'''Ne'gyan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]] he was guarding [[Camp 27]] in the [[Shadow Town]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lord Ne'gyan appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion enemy on Nar Shaddaa.<ref name="SWTOR" />
